author: TeIq
content:
DEFERRED. Same structural blocker as #111: agent worktrees branch off pre-PR-1 base (81e8217), and the agent rewrites #107-#110 from scratch in shapes incompatible with what landed on main. Integration tests need to exercise main's actual federation code — peer_subscribe + verify + state machine + publish + the planned inbound materialize (#175). Authoring the two-instance fixture against main's surface is the right move, not merging the agent's parallel reality.

Filed as follow-up #177 under epic #105 with the AC-1..AC-8 coverage spec from this issue body preserved verbatim.
